description: Sample dataset for evaluating memory retrieval. Memories are short, single-fact statements in the same style produced by MemoryBuilder. Each query lists the memory_ids that a good retriever should return. 'lexical' queries share at least one content word with a relevant memory; 'paraphrase' queries ask for the same information using different words.
